status: RECONSTRUCTED — NOT a previously frozen specification
why_reconstructed: No W2.P2 specification or handoff document exists in the repository, on any branch, in any local worktree, in git history/dangling objects, in any Claude session transcript on this machine, or in production Supabase (recovery inventory: docs/DECISION_MODEL_CONVERGENCE_W2_P2_GATE_CERTIFICATION.md section A). The closest authoritative source is docs/DECISION_MODEL_CONVERGENCE_W2_P1_ROLE_OPPORTUNITY.md section 20 plus the frozen offline thresholds in scripts/w2p1/prereg.json. Every value below is labeled with its provenance.

provenance_labels.VERIFIED: taken verbatim from an existing W2.P1 document or frozen file (source cited)
provenance_labels.INFERRED: follows from the architecture / from VERIFIED items by a stated, mechanical generalization
provenance_labels.PROPOSED: a new safeguard that requires human review before the decision it governs is relied on

frozen_before: any prospective outcome existing: at the commit that adds this file the production store holds 0 LIVE_CAPTURED rows (the migration is not applied and ROLE_SHADOW_CAPTURE is off)

unit_of_evidence.value: one decision per (gsis player, season, week, scoring fingerprint): the LATEST LIVE_CAPTURED, population-eligible record (greatest captured_at, then capture_id)
unit_of_evidence.note: Repeated captures of one decision window are correlated snapshots, never independent decisions (same principle as the Matchup 2.0 evidence gate). 'Latest valid pre-kickoff' mirrors the W1.R1 final-pregame rule (final = latest valid revision). The rule is outcome-blind.

eligible.value: LIVE_CAPTURED; QB/RB/WR/TE; scoring compatible with the frozen HALF fit on every modeled rule; conditional-on-active points >= 3.0; not a bye / no-game week; Role identity join proven; champion baseline present
eligible.source: scripts/w2p1/prereg.json population (relevance floor 3.0, bye exclusion, K/DST not applicable) + the spec statement that other scorings require their own frozen fit

headline.value: eligible AND not known-unavailable (OUT / IR / SUS)
headline.source: prereg.json population.headline_designations (OUT evaluated only to prove the contribution is exactly 0)

covered.value: headline-eligible AND every frozen Role feature present AND Role confidence != INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE (all three arms share this gate)
covered.source: harness `covered` + the brief's 'identical eligibility rules across control and challenger'

tiers.value: STARTER >= 12, FLEX 6 to < 12, FRINGE 3 to < 6 conditional-on-active points
tiers.source: prereg.json population.tiers_by_B0p (applied to the real conditional-active baseline)

outcomes.source: bridge_calibration_cases_current (Projection Calibration Phase 1 ledger): actual_fantasy_points in the league's own scoring
outcomes.accepted: evidence_status = CERTIFIED (LEAGUE_EXACT scoring) and a numeric actual; a DID_NOT_PLAY / INACTIVE row with a null actual scores 0 (a DNP is an outcome, not an exclusion — flagged and counted); every other state is excluded and counted as OUTCOME_NOT_EVALUABLE
outcomes.source: prereg.json population.actual ('a player with no stat line scores 0')

S1_min_completed_weeks_with_outcomes.source: W2.P1 report section 20: 'rerun this exact pre-registered protocol on >= 6 real completed weeks with the real source baseline'

S2_min_covered_decisions_with_outcomes.source: prereg.json T1 (covered FINAL rows >= 300 RB/WR/TE, >= 120 QB), carried forward unchanged

sufficiency.rule: a position below S1 or S2 is reported G3_INSUFFICIENT_PROSPECTIVE_EVIDENCE (a valid scientific outcome, not a failure); no gate is evaluated for it

Q1_champion_vs_challenger.ci: 95% cluster bootstrap over team-weeks, 2000 reps, seed 20250914

Q2_control_vs_challenger.source: prereg.json T2b; the contrast is the frozen Role-free control C0 versus the frozen SHADOW challenger spec
Q2_control_vs_challenger.caveat: The challenger spec deliberately drops the intercept and baseline term while C0 contains them, so this contrast mixes the Role effect with C0's baseline-drift term. The diagnostic C2_FULL-vs-C0 contrast (the offline T2b definition) is reported alongside and is never a gate.

Q4_relative_bias.provenance: VERIFIED (0.15) / PROPOSED (drop of the absolute 0.5 bound)
Q4_relative_bias.source: prereg.json T4 + W2.P1 section 20 ('re-specified ... relative bias'): the absolute bound measured the source's own bias, which no Role feature can fix, and failed for the champion and the control offline

Q5_week_consistency.source: prereg.json T5 ('3 of the 4 FINAL weeks') generalized to the number of evaluated weeks; the VAL clause has no prospective analogue and is dropped

Q6_decisions.source: prereg.json T6 + W2.P1 section 20 ('adequate pair counts')

permutation.scope: Role feature vectors shuffled among headline rows within (week, position); seeded

Q9_leakage.source: prereg.json T9 + W2.P1 section 16 (the offline permutation control was mis-specified); the oracle control has no prospective analogue because every input is stored pre-kickoff

Q10_robustness_std_ppr.reason: needs STD and PPR leagues scored with their own frozen fits; every registered league other than the Bloodline Bowl template is PPR with a -1 interception rule, i.e. not on the frozen fit. Reported as NOT_EVALUABLE, never as a pass.

look_policy.interim: any evaluation before sufficiency is DESCRIPTIVE_INTERIM: it reports estimates but evaluates no gate and may not be cited as qualification evidence
look_policy.decision: the first evaluation after S1 and S2 are met for a model config hash is the DECISION look; its report is logged and a second DECISION look for the same config hash is refused by the CLI unless explicitly acknowledged and then labeled REPEATED_LOOK
look_policy.no_tuning: the challenger and control may not be altered after any look; an altered candidate is a NEW model id and must be scored on weeks captured after its own freeze

verdicts.G3_FAIL: sufficiency met and at least one evaluable gate failed
verdicts.G3_QUALIFIED_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW: sufficiency met and every evaluable gate passed; Q10 remains NOT_EVALUABLE; NEVER an automatic promotion
